answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 6 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 57 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. A quill of doubt is healthy, a thread of proof is required, and a nadir of patience is the price of a clean panel.
